# Advance through evidence gaps

Keep honest evidence gaps actionable in tasks, decisions and handoffs.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Use when an unrun check or uncertain claim is preventing independent authorised work.

Example request:

> Turn this untested adapter decision into bounded next actions and clear completion evidence.

Expected result: A precise gap, the next check, the dependent step and the work that can continue.

## A concrete example

This invented example illustrates the guidance. It is not an observed product result or a benchmark.

**Source facts and constraints:** The adapter implementation is authorised. Compatibility has not been checked. One local client-event check is required before claiming compatibility.

The before text may obscure or overstate those facts. The revision must follow the supplied facts and constraints.

**Before**

> Compatibility is unproven. Stop implementation.

**After**

> Implement the authorised adapter. Check one local client event before claiming compatibility; the check is still pending.

Preserve the source facts, governing meanings and consequential constraints when applying the example to real work.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.6.0 --skill advance-with-uncertainty
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/advance-with-uncertainty/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/advance-with-uncertainty/references/uncertainty.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
